title: Stage 3b (bsc_6): third trigger type, malicious-ratio sweep and poison-rate sweep
detector: Frozen bsc_6 (history off), calibration logs/bsc6_calN, authorized by logs/bsc6_devgate with the declared --attack-variant flag. Source and train_defended.py hashes are recorded per run; train_defended.py/defenses.py changed after Phase 2e only by adding the RFA and Fed-ADH baselines (aggregate_updates and new functions; no fingerprinted protocol function changed).
common: --loss-adjustment logit --logit-tau 0.5, 15 rounds, 8 clients, target Benign, attacked condition only, matched FedAvg per setting and seed

A_third_trigger_type.validity_check_before_data: 41 clean models: worst-case clean triggered->Benign rate per attack class <= 4.1% (eligible <= 10%); blend 0.2 is the code default, not tuned
A_third_trigger_type.criteria: identical to PREREGISTRATION_stage3_variants.json per_seed_criteria and decision rule (V4)

B_malicious_ratio_sweep.fixed: constant trigger columns 5-8 value 5, poison rate 0.5
B_malicious_ratio_sweep.known_limit: 0.5 equals the flagged-fraction stop rule (0.5): a stop is expected once all four attackers are flagged; reported, not redesigned

C_poison_rate_sweep.fixed: constant trigger columns 5-8 value 5, malicious ratio 0.25 (the 0.5 level is shared with sweep B)

sweep_reporting: Descriptive sensitivity curves, not pass/fail: per level mean +/- SD over seeds of final ASR (MediShield and FedAvg), max ASR in rounds 2-15, detection rate, first detection, honest alert FPR, final accuracy and macro-F1, detector stops. Levels where FedAvg's final ASR < 50% are marked 'attack not learned'.
rule: No change to settings, levels or criteria after data are seen.
